response.answer: Lap and pit-stop questions require aggregation; raw dumps are unavailable.
response.sql:
WITH pit AS (
    SELECT ps.race_id, ps.driver_id, ps.milliseconds
    FROM pit_stops ps
    WHERE ps.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c.name AS constructor,
       AVG(p.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS avg_seconds
FROM pit p
JOIN results r ON r.race_id = p.race_id AND r.driver_id = p.driver_id
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id = r.constructor_id
JOIN races ra ON ra.race_id = p.race_id
WHERE ra.year = 2022
GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.name
ORDER BY avg_seconds ASC
LIMIT 5;
